title: Pending-commands predictor pin is vacuous: its draw is span-invalid and is rejected identically on both sides
detail: Draw 0-3 spans (10,10)->(34,15) = sqrt(601) ~24.5 tiles > standard max_span 14: probe run confirms Span_Exceeds_Tier, pipes=0, replay_error=true on BOTH live and shadow (unchecked), so predict==actual passes trivially; no demo command lands in a lead window either.
recommended_fix: Use a valid-span draw (<=14 tiles) and assert !replay_error on live+shadow; add a demo edit inside a telegraph lead window so future-command prediction is golden-pinned.

title: Reveal-buffer >4 trim boundary has no test
detail: New state-bound (the buffer-growth guard for pause/catch-up bursts); the walk-back test stops at 2 reveals, so a broken or reversed trim would stay green. Boundary behavior untested at every level.
recommended_fix: Extend the walk-back test: append >4 NODE_SPAWNED events in one slice and assert len(reveals)==4 with the OLDEST ids evicted first.

title: Reduced-motion telegraph ring and highlight paths untested; the untested highlight path disables the effect its docs promise
detail: Only the reduced-motion REVEAL is unit-pinned (!ok4). The static ring has no test at any level, and the highlight early-returns — no steady band exists, contradicting its own doc comment; a pin would fail today. a11y_reduced.dem runs growth-off so no golden covers either path.
recommended_fix: Unit-pin the static-ring radius/alpha; decide the reduced-motion highlight contract (steady band per docs vs disabled) and pin it; add a growth-on reduced-motion golden capture.

title: Highlight 8-tile radius filter unpinned — golden blesses a map-wide band (tile/px unit mixing)
evidence:
rad := f32(SPAWN_HIGHLIGHT_RADIUS_TILES) * v.tile_px
...
			dx := f32(mid[0]) - f32(r.pos[0])
			dy := f32(mid[1]) - f32(r.pos[1])
			if dx * dx + dy * dy > rad * rad {
				continue
			}
detail: dx,dy are tile-space but rad = 8 x tile_px(26) = 208 in pixel units: effective radius ~208 tiles, so every pipe qualifies. The blessed 04000ms golden shows the band on pipe 1-3 (midpoint 19 tiles from the spawn, dist^2=377) — presence/fade are pinned, the documented scope is not.
recommended_fix: Compare in one unit (drop x tile_px, or scale the deltas); add a unit test with pipes inside and outside 8 tiles so the golden can discriminate the scope.

title: sfx_fixture is not the growth.dem recipe it claims: different positions and its fixture pipe is silently rejected
detail: Probe run: the fixture's apply_edit draw 1-3 returns ok=false err=Span_Exceeds_Tier (span sqrt(509) ~22.6 > 14) and the error return is discarded — the pins run on a pipeless topology that is neither the demo's nor the app's.
recommended_fix: Mirror the harness fixture positions and use a valid-span draw (or assert the apply_edit result) so the pins exercise the blessed timeline.

title: Bad-free fix (growth_test defer removals) is unverifiable by test; 2 pre-existing bad frees remain
detail: Tracker output is not a @(test) assertion — nothing pins the 134->2 improvement. Empirically verified: odin test core now reports exactly 2 bad frees, both in health_test.odin, matching the PR's note.
recommended_fix: Accept as not test-assertable; optionally add a CI gate grepping the test output's bad-free count to keep the tracker signal clean.

title: App-side predict glue (Run-mode gate, per-frame dedup, topology-gen re-predict) never exercised by automation
detail: The harness always predicts force=true per capture, so the app's force=false path — mode gating and the predicted_gen re-predict clause — is pinned only for window dedup, never for the topology-gen dimension.
recommended_fix: Extend test_spawn_fx_predict_dedup: bump topology.gen between non-forced predicts and assert the telegraph re-predicts (retargets).

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0 4/4=100% (ring, reveal, highlight presence/fade, T1 stability — pinned by unit tests + verified goldens). P1 7/8=87.5% (pending-command application 0%: vacuous pin, no golden exercise). Overall P0-P2 ~12/17=71% <80%: reveal trim, reduced-motion ring, reduced-motion highlight, and the 8-tile scope are untested. Suites themselves verified green: 236/236 core, 22/22 render, 47/47 demos, 10/10 gates.
recommended_fix: De-vacuate the pending pin (valid-span draw + !replay_error asserts), add trim and radius-scope unit rows, pin the reduced-motion ring/highlight paths, then re-gate (expect CONCERNS or better).
